description: Noordpolderzijl is a hamlet sluice and the smallest sea harbour on this coast, a narrow basin outside the grass dike. The pumping station stands beside the old sluice and is not a lighthouse. It is overcast, about 10.2°C, with wind near 6.8 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. No boat name is shown. The land-art mosaic is outside the frame.
